Hi Tom & Sara —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned and to surface the asks you called out.

Summary of the call:
- Use case: Customer support triage + internal knowledge retrieval for 15k agents, peak concurrency on chat support, heavy use of private docs and attachments.
- SLOs: 300ms P95 for short responses; batch embedding workloads overnight.
- Scale: pilot: 50k queries/month; production target: ~1.5M queries/month in 9–12 months.
- Priority constraints: data residency (US), SOC2 evidence, and procurement lead time.

Immediate asks / next steps I promised:
1) Mutual Action Plan (attached) — please review and confirm timelines.
2) Introduce economic buyer / budget owner so we can align on licensing & pricing.
3) Procurement checklist & SOC2 evidence — Rishi will share our security pack and a short answers doc.
4) TCO/price card for the pilot and projected run-rate — Vivek will prepare a +3 year TCO (rough numbers) once we have the budget owner details and expected ramp.
5) Schedule a 30-minute pricing & procurement kickoff next week (suggested windows below).

Proposed timeline:
- This week: confirm economic buyer + procurement contact (you mentioned Sara might be involved).
- Next week: pricing & procurement call; Rishi to send SOC2 and security notes.
- End of May: finalize pilot paperwork and start date.

Attachments: Redwood_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (mutual action plan), SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (initial SOW draft)

If you can introduce the budget owner and procurement contact on this thread, we’ll get the TCO and security materials over immediately.
